title: Cyrnel Module Manifest
description: Schema for cyrnel custom module manifests (module.json)

id.description: Unique identifier for the module. Must match /^[A-Za-z_$][A-Za-z0-9_$-]*$/.

name.description: Human-readable display name for the module.

type.description: Module type: 'adapter' (provides tools via external API) or 'environment' (executes user code).

main.description: Relative path to the built ESM entry file the host can import().
